title: Lizer's Vanilla Remake
description: a modpack that aims to enhance your vanilla minecraft experience in many ways
body:
Have you ever wanted more from your vanilla experience in Minecraft? Now you can!

I have created this modpack to enhance your vanilla experience like never before. Think of a mod you'd like for a vanilla world, and you can be sure that this modpack has it already!

The main reason for this modpack's creation is because i have started to get bored from a classic vanilla on minecraft, and i think many can relate to this.

Some of the many mods included in this modpack are the following:

1. **_Terralith Biomes:_** this mod aims to amplify the variety of biomes, while adding new structures too! 

2. **_Dungeons and Taverns:_** similar to Towns and Towers, this mod adds new structures to find during your exploration in the world, making your adventure never boring

3. **_Yung's mods:_** this "bundle" of mods aim to recreate already existing structures and biomes, like the end island, better fortresses, stronghold and many more, making your adventure and exploration of such places more intriguing!

4. **_Many Tweaks:_** there are alot of tweaks to make your experience in any world smoother and better compared to the standard minecraft, like sodium and more.

5. **_First Person:_** this mod aims to make your adventure more immersive with a first person mod instead of the classic style from minecraft

And many more!!
